description: This file defines the 'Setting' controller class within the Opencart admin task for catalog settings. It handles tasks like generating setting tasks, creating JSON configuration files per store and language, and clearing generated files.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class for managing catalog settings tasks such as generating configuration files and task scheduling within the Opencart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes tasks for store and language settings, creating task entries for each store and language combination and returning success message.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Generates a JSON configuration file for a specific store based on its settings and related data, returning a success or error message.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the generated JSON configuration file for a specific store to clear cached data.
